results.content: Nationally, 35 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance while 59 percent disapprove as of August 28, leaving him underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. The survey has garnered 126,586 responses since January 20, 2025, when Trump was inaugurated for a second term. [...] An August 25 Economist/YouGov poll found 35 percent of Americans approved of the president's job performance, with a net approval rating of -26. Compared to a similar poll during the same point in his first term, his net approval rating was -9 and former Democratic President Joe Biden’s -12. [...] According to Nate Silver's Silver Bullet

President Donald Trump's approval rating is underwater in 11 states that the president won by double digits in the 2024 election, Newsweek reports, a potentially troubling sign as the crucial fall midterm elections approach.

Trump has a 36% approval rating nationwide, according to Civiqs' online tracking poll of registered voters. [...] Trump's approval went negative in some of those states after he announced his tariff program in April of 2025.

Other states turned on the president after he announced his war with Iran this February.
